paper_id: MPInspector_ A Systematic and Automatic Approach for Evaluating the Security of IoT Messaging Protocols
title: MPInspector: A Systematic and Automatic Approach for Evaluating the Security of IoT Messaging Protocols
motivation: IoT messaging protocol implementations are fragmented and not carefully implemented for security; no systematic solution exists for automatic security checks.
problem_framing: How to build an automatic tool to verify security properties of MP implementations across diverse IoT platforms with closed-source and customized implementations?
key_insight: Combining model learning (active learning of state machines) with formal verification (Tamarin Prover) enables systematic, black-box security analysis without needing source code.
method_signature: Three-stage pipeline: extract parameter semantics + interaction logic → infer state machine → generate security properties → formal verification
evaluation_criteria: 252 property violations, 11 attacks, 100% precision, 4.5h average overhead across 9 platforms
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Traditional Tamarin Prover may fail to prove properties for complex state transitions; solved by designing helping oracle to guide proof.
evidence_for_taste: model learning cannot be directly applied
may be trapped into an endless learning procedure
The adapter invokes the corresponding pre-installed encryption interface
it does not make sense to continue searching
The main root causes are the gap between ad-hoc MP implementations
thinking_moves: 把黑盒安全分析问题重构成可学习的有限状态机建模问题
先用标准规范定义元属性，再根据实际实现扩展为具体属性
用模式匹配解决常见加密参数，用NLP处理文档中的未知自定义加密
通过限制相同假设生成次数来应对模型学习的非确定性陷阱
通过剪枝无效查询（已关闭连接的路径）来加速状态机学习
